Review `.github/agents`, `.github/skills`, `.github/prompts` and relevant workflows.

## Review goals

- Find overlapping responsibilities.
- Identify missing capabilities.
- Check routing and delegation.
- Check evidence and security requirements.
- Check token-efficiency guidance.
- Check prompt consistency.

## Output

- Inventory.
- Overlap findings.
- Missing roles/skills.
- Token-consumption risks.
- Prioritized improvements.
- Proposed files and acceptance criteria.

Read directory listings first and inspect only representative files before expanding scope.
